title: Persistence of a False Validity Flag
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $st$ be a verifier state, and let $o$ be either no cell or a cell value. If the validity flag of $st$ is false, then the validity flag after applying the option-valued verifier step to $st$ and $o$ is also false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
The validity flag of $st$ is false
